Title: Discover SCUBA Diving  2 Dives 【Minna, Sesoko , Motobu Okinawa】
Description:
For non-Certified divers.


This course is for those who have never dived, those who have been away from diving, or those who are worried.

Would you like to enjoy the sea on the main island of Okinawa with us?

You can enjoy with one Instructor who will give you guidance as private VIP services.


【Safe even for beginners】

 Experienced instructors who have been active in Japan and abroad for a long time will respond one-on-one. 

Courses will be held on request based on your pace.  


[Safe for foreigners] 

Staff who can speak English fluently will be happy to assist you. 


 [VIP private course] 

We offer a complete one-on-one course with no other guests. 

We will respond to your age, physical condition and preference.  


[With insurance on course] 

We have insurance which is suitable for injuries of customers and heat stroke.


  [Photograph gifts during the course] 

You will receive a free photo of the customer in the course.
